'''Force Shrines''' were a sacred space constructed by an unknown civilization at some point during [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]]. They were built on [[Vergence/Legends|places]] strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and contained no known entrances or inside chambers. Identical structures could be found on a number of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and are known to be found on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. 

==Behind the scenes==
Mysterious Shrines appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and provided a place for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] player characters to meditate. They could be found on all of the planets in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', except for [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] (the two [[Planet/Legends|planets]] added to the game by expansion packs).
